releaseNotes:
## Bookings
- Four-pane booking form: guest & family | arrival/departure | rooms | remarks & allergies
- Click rooms in availability to reserve one or two rooms for the same stay
- Assign people to each room when two rooms are reserved

## Conferences
- Save event works reliably and shows a saved confirmation
- Family parties stay grouped; Edit party updates travel and all members together
- Delete participants from the room view
- More compact participants room board

## Fixes & polish
- Settings and forms show clearer save feedback
- Recovery code / forgot-password flow (admin recovery)
- Favicon / app icons
